chapter_mission: Vectivus asteroid arrival; the visions of Darth Vectivus confirm the Sith-lineage explicitly; Jacen's philosophical frame aligns with what the asteroid is teaching.
chapter_turn: The setting reframes Lumiya's argument — seeing Vectivus's life in the Force makes the Sith-with-love thesis feel like inheritance rather than theory.

scene_plan.purpose: Arrival at the asteroid; first tour of the chambers; Vectivus visions begin.
Ben's child's-eye-view of the asteroid; unease without identification.

exit_vector: Jacen standing at the threshold of the asteroid's inner chambers, Ben beside him, the next step a choice.
notes: The asteroid's architecture and Vectivus's Force-echoes do philosophical work the dialogue cannot.
